thread:
leah_security: Heads up — after the RBAC tighten that landed at 10:00 UTC, we’re seeing TLS handshake latency spikes and KMS denies for keystore access from edge proxies in eu-west-1 and ap-south-1. Not a full outage but noticeable error churn.
raj_infra: ack. do you have a sample log line?
leah_security: here — 
```\nKMS: decrypt DENY principal=svc-proxy-keystore region=eu-west-1 resource=projects/keystore/keys/primary reason=permission_denied
proxy: tls: handshake error: remote error: unknown ca (client=10.2.3.45)
```\nraj_infra: thanks. that DENY looks like the service account lost the `keystore-reader` role in the rollout. which policy was applied?
tom_sre: curious — are proxies failing to present client certs or is the upstream rejecting them? the `unknown ca` suggests upstream didn't accept the cert chain, could be a keystore read failure causing fallback to default cert.
leah_security: exactly — our hypothesis: when keystore decrypt fails, code falls back to disk cert which is expired in some regions, leading to handshake retries and latency.
nina_devex: @raj_infra can you confirm which IAM change PR landed? it had a bunch of role removals for shadow creds.
raj_infra: PR #4927 — removed a couple of legacy roles; I thought the new role mapping covered svc-proxy-keystore but looks like a miss in the regional bindings for eu-west-1 and ap-south-1. rolling rollback in progress.
deploybot: deploy 1755.6 -> rollback started by @raj_infra at 10:24 UTC :arrow_backward:
leah_security: audit question: audit logs show lots of `permission_denied` but some entries are missing the actor context — looks like a suppressed audit log from the rotator job. auditbot, any ideas?
auditbot: found: rotator runs under `rotator-service` and has partial audit suppression set in `org-policy-audit.yaml` for legacy key ops. suppression triggered when role == 'legacy-rotator'. turning off suppression for keystore decrypts will surface better context.
leah_security: ok please change policy to allow decrypt events to log with full actor. we need to trace which fallback path hit.
raj_infra: rollback complete in eu-west-1 at 10:33. after rollback, KMS denies drop to baseline and handshake latency normalizes. ap-south-1 still rolling.
tom_sre: action items: 1) audit policy change to un-suppress decrypts (nina) 2) update RBAC mapping to include svc-proxy-keystore in regional binding (raj) 3) add a soft-fail path that bubbles a metric when keystore decrypt fails so we don't silently fallback to expired cert (leah).
nina_devex: noted — I'll open a small PR for the audit.yaml change and ping security for review.
leah_security: also add a shortpostmortem note in incidents channel once ap-south is verified. we should flag this as vuln-triage-adjacent since fallout was from shadow role removals.
raj_infra: will follow up with the exact binding diff. thanks all. :thumbsup:
leah_security: thanks — closing thread once ap-south is green and audit logs show full actor context.
